name: Elijah: Family Above All
description: Play as Elijah Mikaelson.  Night in New Orleans, and the city is burning.  You're in your own house in the Garden District: a parlor with the piano you play when the red door in your mind won't stay shut, a library of first editions, a wine cabinet, a fridge of blood bags, and a crypt where Rebekah, Kol and Finn sleep with silver daggers in their hearts.  Behind a painting in your bedroom, in a safe no one else knows exists, is the white oak stake: the only thing in the world that can kill you.  Niklaus is out there somewhere, and so is the last of the Petrova blood.
